description.value: Affirmation Coffee is a newly renovated neighborhood café on Bowen Road in Nanaimo, focused on freshly crafted coffee and homemade baked goods made from locally sourced ingredients. Reviewers highlight standout lattes, Biscoff cheesecake, muffins, and classic Nanaimo bars in a clean, uncluttered space. It offers a comfortable spot to sit down and recharge mid-ride in the north end of Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is open and operating at 2220 Bowen Rd, Nanaimo, BC with phone (250) 751-4141, matching OSM data. The site describes a café serving coffee and homemade baked goods but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout explicitly, or any cyclist-specific amenities. All subpages returned identical content, suggesting the Google Sites scrape did not capture unique subpage content (e.g. a detailed menu), so amenity fields that depend on those pages remain null.
concerns: All scraped subpages (About Us, Menu, Contact Us) returned identical content — the Google Sites scraper likely did not render unique subpage content. Menu items and any additional amenity details are therefore unavailable from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café with a live website, positive reviews, and confirmed contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists passing through north Nanaimo.
